title: Toshiaki Yamada's Tokyo Duel Manga Ends
content:
Coamix 's Comic Zenon + manga website published the final chapter of Toshiaki Yamada 's Tokyo Duel ( Tokyo Kettō Kanjōsen ) manga on September 23. The final chapter became free to read on Wednesday.

Coamix publishes the manga volumes in English digitally. Comikey also releases the manga and describes the story:

In post-war Japan, a government-funded program of organized violence called the "Tokyo Loop Line Duels" is promoted to maintain law and order—and it works. Representatives from each station on the Yamanote line battle for control of their territory. Any defeat could mean losing family members, friends, money—or worse. Fast-forward to now, in 2020; a new station has opened up. Everyone, including the popular rookie, Koinosuke, is itching to join the fray for the top spot. Will he be victorious? Or will violence consume them all?

Yamada launched the manga on Comic Zenon + in 2020. Coamix will publish the manga's 22nd and final compiled book volume on November 20.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement for Fall 2026 Is Finally Ready to Level Up
content:
Crunchyroll featuring a new anime every season that can be compared to Solo Leveling has become a norm, and the latest one airing this fall proves it is a perfect replacement as it starts its main journey with the second episode. While the summer season had Tomb Raider King as the latest Korean webtoon anime adaptation that followed Solo Leveling ‘s upgrading journey, the fall has Overgeared , which also had an official collaboration with Solo Leveling , leading fans to interpret the new series as carrying the baton of Solo Leveling this season. Despite having the Solo Leveling element in its premise, Overgeared is a series of its own .

The first episode revealed a miserable protagonist deprived of money and good status, seeking them in the game Satisfy, which affects the elements of his real life. With the in-game name Grid, the protagonist pushes himself and ends up acquiring a legendary class status as the successor of a blacksmith, but this brings him back down to level 1. The first episode comically reveals that Grid continues to lose rank as he is still trying to comprehend his status change. By the end of the first episode, however, Grid understands his legendary status, and the second episode of the series has officially started the leveling-up journey that it promised, and it is perfect.

Overgeared Finally Begins Its Protagonist’s Leveling-Up Journey

After taking a while to realize that his class as a Blacksmith isn’t about going off into battle but rather making tools, Grid takes the necessary steps and starts learning the work of a blacksmith from an NPC, with his first task being to chop a thousand pieces of wood. Though it is a task that he finds tedious, due to the precision Grid gains from his class as a blacksmith, it still pushes him to work all night to complete it. Eventually, he also gains a level upgrade through the process. The episode then sees Grid taking on his next main job as a blacksmith.

To make money, Grid begins crafting arrows, hoping to sell them and earn money, and thanks to his skills, Grid ends up making some epic-level arrows as well, giving him more money while also upgrading his level to three. This episode finally sees Grid beginning a journey of redeeming himself and gaining status within the game, thanks to his crafted arrows receiving recognition. In essence, the second episode gives Grid the exposure he requires to gain the level upgrades and recognition that the series has implied, making it feel very similar to Solo Leveling ‘s journey .

However, the anime carries its own essence throughout, and it is all thanks to the protagonist’s uniqueness, which is essentially his shameful nature and his willingness to beg for help. Grid feels like a real-life character who is desperate enough to make it in life and would do anything for it, and even though he has the trick to level up quicker, Grid’s uniqueness doesn’t fade. This is enough to make Solo Leveling and Overgeared worlds apart, given that Jinwoo’s coolness and combat ability are what define him the most, while Overgeared has a protagonist with the opposite personality and a crafting-based ability. Overgeared is a replacement for Solo Leveling on Crunchyroll this fall , but with its own nuances that make it very refreshing.

title: Netflix’s Most Romantic Series of Fall 2026 Makes Its Return With the Perfect Romantic Drama
content:
The Fall 2026 season is here, meaning every major platform is streaming new and returning content, and with Netflix being one of the biggest streaming platforms, it continues to shine this season as well. Recently, Netflix has expanded its reach and emerged as a leading streaming platform in the anime industry. It has done so by streaming many ongoing anime each season, albeit a little later, while also featuring some exclusives that fans won’t find anywhere else. With the Fall 2026 season bringing a wave of new anime, Netflix is streaming many of them, including two exclusives as well.

While JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure ‘s latest part is undoubtedly stealing the spotlight as the Netflix exclusive this Fall, Blue Box , the romantic sports anime, has also arrived this season with a new season, perfectly presenting the autumn vibe with its premiere. Fans of Blue Box have been waiting for the premiere of this season for a while, as it was poised to feature the first official date that fans have been longing to see. The first episode of the series featured Taiki and Chinatsu’s first date, albeit it wasn’t the perfect one. Rather, it featured the perfect clichéd moments of a first date, and before it could come to an end as a sweet date, it ended on a heavy note, reminding fans what this romantic series’ main notion is.

Netflix’s Returning Romantic Series of Fall 2026 Perfectly Captures Its Core Theme

What makes Blue Box a great romantic series on Netflix is that it doesn’t put its romantic element at the forefront; rather, it is a secondary element, proving that romance doesn’t always have to be on screen to make itself felt. Instead, the romantic emotions are portrayed through the characters’ dedication to sports. Chinatsu and Taiki’s dynamic is built around sports, as the latter idolizes the former’s dedication and falls for her commitment to the sport. With this feeling only growing in a mutual way, the series has now finally featured a date between them. However, this isn’t all about romance and sweetness, as both Taiki and Chinatsu are reminded that they have to worry about something even bigger than this: sports.

Taiki is reminded of this through the third-wheeling guy, who bluntly expresses this to Taiki’s face. Though Taiki dwells on the comment, he defiantly says that he can handle both a relationship and his sports, though there is a lot of hesitation in this. But what makes this notion even better is how Chinatsu is presented with this truth even more aggressively. The whole episode subtly introduces a character from Chinatsu’s past, Yumeka, who is revealed to have been her basketball partner in middle school but gave up on it in high school.

The episode ends with Yumeka appearing, and after she sees Chinatsu with Taiki at what is clearly a couple’s spot, she interprets that Taiki is Chinatsu’s boyfriend and nonchalantly says that having a boyfriend means Chinatsu has given up on basketball. With the episode emphasizing for the second time that sports is not a joke and that a relationship can be a hurdle, it highlights the perfect blend of romance and sports. But what makes Chinatsu and Taiki’s dynamic work so well is that they comprehend the sports element more than others, and thus, seeing them figure out their relationship while becoming the best at their respective sports is what will make Blue Box great and emerge as an even more amazing romantic series on Netflix that fans can and should be watching.

title: Monster Hunter Rise Game Sells 20 Million Copies Worldwide
content:
The official X/Twitter account for CAPCOM 's Monster Hunter franchise announced on Friday that the Monster Hunter Rise game has surpassed 20 million copies sold worldwide.

Monster Hunter Rise launched on Nintendo Switch in March 2021 and then launched on PC via Steam in January 2022. CAPCOM released the game on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Windows, and Xbox Game Pass in January 2023. The Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak expansion for the game debuted for Switch and PC via Steam in June 2022, and launched on PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Windows, and Xbox Game Pass in April 2023.

Monster Hunter Wilds , the latest main game in the franchise , debuted globally on PS5, Xbox X|S, and PC via Steam in February 2025. The game sold over 8 million copies worldwide in its first three days. According to the company, this is the fastest that one of its titles has reached this milestone. As of March 2025, the game had sold 10 million copies worldwide. The game's Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance expansion will launch in 2027. The game will get a Nintendo Switch 2 release on December 4.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Streams New Battle Spirits TV Anime
content:
The anime premiered on Tuesday at 11:00 p.m. JST on Tokyo MX and other channels.

The anime stars:

• Taichi Kusano as Kū Bashin, a cheerful, positive, sincere fan of Battle Spirits who wants to become stronger

• Daiki Hamano as Zetsu Ajara, a cool, unapproachable rōnin, feared as an Eternal Battler master assassin

• Hiro Shimono as Ibuki Mizuha

• Mariya Ise as Yui Kusumoto

• Yasuhiro Mamiya as Suiboku Bashin

• Nana Mizuki as Mine Kusumoto

• Megu Umezawa as Shie Anpachi

• Akira Ishida as Jinzan Takasugi

• Daisuke Ono as Ryо̄ga Sakamoto

• Jun Fukuyama as Kakeru Magi

• Shizuka Miyano (CANDY TUNE) as Shizu

• Miyuki Satō as Fukumaru

• Junichi Suwabe as Narrator

Masashi Kudo ( Terminator Zero , Sanrio Boys , Hayate the Combat Butler! Cuties ) is directing the anime at Bandai Namco Pictures and is also credited for the original character designs. Toshizo Nemoto ( Inu X Boku Secret Service , Metallic Rouge , Log Horizon two seasons) is in charge of series scripts. Bandai Namco Pictures is also credited for planning the production.

JAM Project perform the opening theme song "Here we are!" Himegoto will perform the ending theme song "Pulse."

Bandai launched its original Battle Spirits trading card game in 2008. In the game, cards represent dragons, demons, birds, insects, and other spirits that the players can control in battles. Bandai imported the game to the United States in 2009. Battle Spirits: Connected Battlers , the latest video game in the franchise , launched for PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch in April 2022.

The franchise launched the 50-episode Battle Spirits: Shōnen Toppa Bashin anime series in September 2008. A new television anime series aired almost every year afterwards until 2016-2017's Battle Spirits Double Drive .

A three-episode net anime series titled Battle Spirits: Saga Brave then premiered in June 2019. Battle Spirits: Kakumei no Galett launched in August 2020. Battle Spirits: Mirage , the most recent anime in the franchise , premiered online in October 2021.

title: K Manga Adds Sen Sen Senki Manga
content:
Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Tuesday that it will add author A-10 and illustrator Ryūga Kawasaki's Sen Sen Senki manga on October 13.

A-10 and Kawasaki debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine on June 10. Kodansha published the first compiled book volume on September 16.

The dark fantasy story takes place during an era in which countries are divisive. After a warlord conquers and destroys a small country, a young boy named Raika is taken prisoner. After Raika escapes and encounters a mysterious sage, he vows to become one himself to save others from the warlord.

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Anime Streams in India on October 11
content:
Crunchyroll announced on Monday that it will simultaneously stream the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus television anime series in India on October 11. The anime will stream in Japanese with English subtitles.

Netflix will stream the series in India beginning on October 14.

The series will begin airing on the Fuji TV channel and its affiliates on October 11 at 11:15 p.m. JST (10:15 a.m. EDT), taking over the timeslot of the One Piece anime, which aired its last episode for this year on September 27. The series will also stream on Amazon Prime Video and U-NEXT streaming services in Japan 30 minutes after its broadcast at 12:15 a.m. JST.

The first episode will also screen in advance at the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Special Panel at New York Comic Con on October 8.

The staff for the new anime includes:

• Composition and Direction Arrangement: Matsuto Seya

• Animation Character Design & General Animation Director: Tadayoshi Yamamuro

• Editing: Eiichi Nishimura

• Compositing Director: Yōsuke Motoki

• Music: Norihito Sumitomo

The anime will again feature Kōichi Yamadera as Beerus.

MEGATERA･ZERO performs the opening theme song "ONOGAMI," and VK Blanka performs the ending theme song "Kan Peki No Peki."

Akio Iyoku stated the work started a few years ago and is an "enhanced" edition of the Dragon Ball Super anime that features a reconstruction of the story, and includes new and redrawn cuts.

The official announcement of the anime stated:

The project features extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story. Living up to the name ENHANCED, this edition employs the latest visual expression to deliver greater power and immersion across all scenes, especially the battle sequences. The result is an ENHANCED edition that expresses Akira Toriyama 's original idea and worldbuilding more accurately, that will be broadcasted with highly satisfying quality.

The anime staff stated, "the anime Dragon Ball Super ... is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus in Fall 2026."

The staff describes the story:

Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an Earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

Dragon Ball Super premiered in July 2015 and aired for 131 episodes until March 2018. Funimation and Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and Funimation released the series on home video. Funimation debuted the English dub to its streaming service in December 2016. The English dub premiered on Adult Swim 's Toonami block in January 2017.
author: ANN

title: 2 Years Later, Surprise Crunchyroll Isekai Confirms Season 3 Return
content:
A surprise Isekai anime series that you can now watch on Crunchyroll has confirmed that it’s now in the works on a third season after a two year absence. There are lots of new Isekai anime series coming to Crunchyroll for the Fall 2026 anime schedule , and it will help to cap off what has been a strong year for the genre overall. There will always be more Isekai anime to watch, however, with many more new releases and franchise returns to keep an eye out for in the immediate future.

Some of these returns are a surprise, however , and that’s the case for the anime adaptation for Yuri Kitayama and Riv’s Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles . The first season of the series made its debut back in 2021, and the second season then followed two years later. But there was no confirmation of a potential third season until now as the official social media for the series has now revealed that Season 3 of the anime is now in production.

Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles Season 3 Announced

Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles Season 3 has been officially announced to be in the works two years after the release of the second season, but no release window or date has been announced at this time. No real concrete details have been given for the series, however, as there has also yet to be any production staff, potential returning voice cast, and other details revealed as of this initial announcement. But given the three year gap in between the first two seasons, there could be a chance we’ll see this next season coming our way in 2027 if everything works out.

Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles is an interesting Isekai franchise as when its protagonist finds himself in another world, his memories of his previous life don’t kick in until he’s been in this new fantasy world for years. Fueled with his knowledge of his life in Japan and a mysterious power that seems to be stemming from that, Rio now tries his best to work his way up from the slums in this fantasy world to a better life. All the while, he meets some interesting allies and foes along the way to make his life more complicated.

What to Know for Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles

If you wanted to catch up with everything that’s happened in the first two seasons so far, you can find Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles now streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime with both Japanese and English language audio. The Isekai series likely isn’t the most notable when compared to some of the other wild ideas you might have seen floating around for the past few year s, but it’s one you should dig into as the idea of Rio gaining his past memories later in life makes for a fun wrinkle to the usual set up.

This is also one of the Isekai franchises with a traditional power fantasy set up, and doesn’t really get too intense over the course of its episodes. If you want to watch a main character use his broken abilities to get ahead without much push back , this is the one for you. But are you curious to see more of Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

Some of these returns are a surprise, however , and that’s the case for the anime adaptation for Yuri Kitayama and Riv’s Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles . The first season of the series made its debut back in 2021, and the second season then followed two years later. But there was no confirmation of a potential third season until now as the official social media for the series has now revealed that Season 3 of the anime is now in production.
Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles Season 3 Announced

Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles Season 3 has been officially announced to be in the works two years after the release of the second season, but no release window or date has been announced at this time. No real concrete details have been given for the series, however, as there has also yet to be any production staff, potential returning voice cast, and other details revealed as of this initial announcement. But given the three year gap in between the first two seasons, there could be a chance we’ll see this next season coming our way in 2027 if everything works out.

Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles is an interesting Isekai franchise as when its protagonist finds himself in another world, his memories of his previous life don’t kick in until he’s been in this new fantasy world for years. Fueled with his knowledge of his life in Japan and a mysterious power that seems to be stemming from that, Rio now tries his best to work his way up from the slums in this fantasy world to a better life. All the while, he meets some interesting allies and foes along the way to make his life more complicated.
What to Know for Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles

If you wanted to catch up with everything that’s happened in the first two seasons so far, you can find Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles now streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime with both Japanese and English language audio. The Isekai series likely isn’t the most notable when compared to some of the other wild ideas you might have seen floating around for the past few year s, but it’s one you should dig into as the idea of Rio gaining his past memories later in life makes for a fun wrinkle to the usual set up.

This is also one of the Isekai franchises with a traditional power fantasy set up, and doesn’t really get too intense over the course of its episodes. If you want to watch a main character use his broken abilities to get ahead without much push back , this is the one for you. But are you curious to see more of Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2 Anime Reveals Same-Day Dub Release, Cast
content:
The dub (featuring returning members) stars:

• Anastasia Muñoz as Azest

• Austin Tindle as Desir

• Sarah Roach as Romantica

• Macy Anne Johnson as Pram

• John Archer II as Wilhelm

• William Ofoegbu as Hawk

• Corey Pettit as Priscilla

• Jamie Lee as Mysterious Girl

• Rebecca Chiara Marano as Lirika

• Jim Foronda as Zod

• Aiden Call as Emil

• Ben Bryant as Jeffran

The dub staff includes:

• Studio: Crunchyroll

• Studio Producers: Justin Cook, Michael Harcourt, Nathanael Harrison

• Producer: Samantha Herek

• Adaptation Supervisor: Jarrod Greene

• Adaptation: Chris Cason

• Adaptation Prep: Michael Nicholson

• Voice Director: Jeremy Inman

• Assistant Voice Director: Michael Stimac

• Talent Coordination: Tara A. Williams, Brittni Hurley

• Engineer Managers: Gino Palencia, Brandon Peters

• Engineer: Seth Aulds

• Assistant Engineer: Darius Blackmon

• Mixer: Neal Malley

The new season will premiere in Fuji TV 's " +Ultra " programming block on Wednesday, and it will run on Wednesdays at 24:45 (effectively, Thursdays at 12:45 a.m.). The anime will also run on Kansai TV on Thursday, and on Tōkai TV and AT-X on Saturday. The anime will first stream in Japan on the d Anime Store , d Anime Store Nico Nico Branch, d Anime Store for Prime Video and for LINE Manga, U-NEXT , and Anime Hōdai streaming services on Wednesday at 25:15 JST (effectively Thursday at 1:15 a.m.). It will then stream on other streaming services in Japan on Sunday. Crunchyroll will stream the new season.

The anime lists returning cast members Show Hayami as Jord Exarion and Ayako Kawasumi as Priscilla Heisilkeite. The anime also lists Tarusuke Shingaki as the Bird Mask.

Yen Press is releasing the series in English and it describes the story:

In a time when the Shadow World has taken over and most of humanity is wiped out, a party of six heroes strives and fails to save the world… But magician Desir Herman is given a second chance when he opens his eyes and finds that he's gone back thirteen years in the past! It's now up to him to gather his party once more and stop the greatest catastrophe in human history!

The anime's cast includes:

• Takuma Terashima as Desir Herman

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Romantica Eru

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Pram Schnaizer

• Asami Seto as Azrest Kingscrown

Taishi Kawaguchi returns to direct the anime at Arvo Animation , nad Takamitsu Kouno ( She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man , Absolute Duo , We Without Wings - Under the Innocent Sky ) returns to oversee and write the scripts. Hiromi Katō ( Violinist of Hamelin , Kobato. , Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut ) is designing the characters, and Daisuke Negishi is the art director. Kenta Higashiohji ( Pole Princess!! ) returns to compose the music. Rock band FLOW perform opening theme song "Sorrow." Singer-songwriter krage performs the ending theme song "Everlasting."

Other staff include:

• Art Design: Satoshi Fujimoto, Taiga Saitō, Takeshi Mukai, Tetsuo Imaizumi

• Prop Design: Shōtarō Hashiguchi

• Color Key Artist: Aiko Matsuyama

• Compositing Director of Photography: Hideki Imaizumi

• Editing: Gō Sadamatsu

• Sound Director: Takatoshi Hamano

• Sound Effects: Yasumasa Koyama

The first season of the anime debuted in October 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in English-speaking, Latin America, and European countries, along with an English dub .

title: The Apothecary Diaries Creator Teases New Story Changes for Season 3
content:
The Apothecary Diaries has returned to action with its third season of episodes now airing this Fall, and the creator behind it all is teasing some new changes to the story for this next season. The Fall 2026 anime schedule has kickstarted a wave of new anime releases through the month, and this includes some of the most highly anticipated franchise returns of the year. One of these returns was for The Apothecary Diaries as it has sparked a whole new mystery for Maomao to get to the bottom of.

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has started to lay the groundwork for the central mystery that we’ll see play out through the rest of the Fall, but it seems like there are going to be even more surprises in store for the coming season than expected. Taking to social media , series creator Natsu Hyuga explained that this new season allowed them to add additional material to further flesh out some of the events in “greater depths” seen in the light novel and manga releases.

The Apothecary Diaries Creator Teases New Scenes in Season 3

“There are many parts where Season 3 comes before the manga,” Hyuga stated in a message to fans on social media. “While the original work is a novel, many aspects have been explored in greater depths through the manga. Keeping this in mind, I’ve been allowed to add additional material.” While Hyuga does not go into detail about the kinds of additional material that they have added to the new season’s scenes , it’s definitely good news for fans of the anime as it’s likely going to now be the most complete version of the story.

Thanks to the manga adaptation further enhancing the original novel version of the story, The Apothecary Diaries is now able to take things even further with the anime adaptation for this third season. The story between Jinshi and Maomao seems like it will be reaching a turning point through all of the promotional materials released thus far, so hopefully some of this additional material further extends to those moments. It’s something that fans of the wider franchise would surely appreciate above all else.

How to Watch The Apothecary Diaries Season 3

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is now streaming its new episodes with Crunchyroll this Fall in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS and Indian Subcontinent (along with being available for Netflix only in select regions of Asia). This new season will be running for 24 episodes in total across two cours. The first half of the episodes will be wrapping up this Fall, but then it will be returning for its second half of episodes next April.

There are all sorts of new projects for The Apothecary Diaries in the works at the moment too. Not only is there a new movie hitting theaters in Japan later this year, but there’s also a new video game release coming next year. There’s also a new live-action series now in development for Prime Video too . We’re going to see much more of the franchise, so how are you feeling about The Apothecary Diaries right now? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
